contexts.text: He may then be very sure that such Spirits are with him...
A temptation against the Lord's love, which wanted to be made certain, sig. AC 1820.
Certainty concerning the issue precedes victory, and is of victory.
To know for certain that it was from the Divine, sig.
What is reciprocal if there is certainty, sig. Because a pledge was for the sake of certainty...
That it was certain, sig. A pledge = certainty thence.

To hasten does not signify quickly, but what is certain, and also what is full... Thus haste of time (implies) that there are many things working together, whence there results a certain and full issue.
Let Pharaoh live () = what is certain... AC 5453. AC 5454.
A perception that now conjunction was sure. Signified. To haste in coming = sure conjunction.
In me, Lord () = what is certain; being a form of asseveration.
Thus shall ye make it () = a sure and genuine representative, (because the expression is repeated, and forms the close).
Whether you say faith, or the settled thought of man, is the same thing.
The things which must quickly be done () = the things which must certainly be, lest the Church should perish.
It is certain that the New Church... will come into existence... and it is also certain that the falsities of the former Church must first be removed...
Behold, I come quickly () = that the Lord will certainly come.
Who speaks more persuadedly of the certainty of his phantasy than a naturalistic atheist?
